parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT json_agg(k) FROM (SELECT sku, colecao, preco_shopify_cents, preco_aprovado_cents, preco_status, foto_url, foto_origem, ativo, ausente_syncs, (foto_b64 IS NOT NULL) AS tem_foto FROM hz_catalogo) k) AS catalogo, (SELECT json_object_agg(chave, valor) FROM hz_config WHERE chave IN ('alertas_ativos','foto_modelo_permitida','modo_foto')) AS config;

parameters.jsCode:
const f = ($('Montar Upsert Catalogo').first().json || {}).fotos_novas || [];
return f.filter(x => /^https:\/\/cdn\.shopify\.com\//i.test(String(x.foto_url)) && /^[A-Z0-9-]+$/.test(String(x.sku))).map(x => ({ json: { sku: x.sku, foto_url: x.foto_url } }));
